title: Scales of Justice
description:
Name: [Geburah](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/geburah.png:150:150)
Known Locations: The Briah Dimension, entered through Eye of Geburah.
Estimated Size: Huge
Behavior: Judges both Accused and itself for sins. Throughout the fight, the bells will ring, signifying a change in the current sins and the screens at its base will show the current "sin," such as jumping or not dropping all Crystals of Sin in inventory. Performing these actions will add a sin to the opponent, shown on the left of their screen. Geburah cannot be harmed by traditional means and must be made to commit a sin itself, a common method being to lure a Judgement Bird over a glowing trap on the ground to chain it in place and have Geburah kill the bird with its laser attacks. Geburah can shoot projectiles and lasers from its base, along with creating shockwaves and spectral hammers. It's most powerful attack is creating a ring of red and blue bells while balancing matching orbs on its scales. These bells must be destroyed in order to balance the scales, as the damage of the attack will grow based on how unbalanced it is. At half health, or 5 sins commited, Geburah will start changing the current sins more often and ocassionally designating 2 sins at once.
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly
